```{r}
process_experiment_data <- function(data_filepath, 
                                    stimulus_filepath, 
                                    output_prefix,
                                    trial_outlier_min = 5,
                                    trans_outlier_min = 10,
                                    att_outlier_min = 2) {
  
  # --- 1. Load Data ---
  print(paste("--- Loading data from:", data_filepath, "---"))
  data <- read_csv(data_filepath)
  
  # --- 2. Initial Data Inspection ---
  print("--- All Variable Names ---")
  print(colnames(data))
  print("--- Total Unique Participants (Raw) ---")
  print(paste("N =", n_distinct(data$participant_id)))
  print("--- Unique Block Names ---")
  print(unique(data$block_name))
  print("--- Unique Eligibility Values ---")
  print(unique(data$branch_eligiblenotEligible))
  
  data_clean <- data %>%
    filter(branch_eligiblenotEligible == "eligible")
  
  print(paste("N of Eligible Participants =", n_distinct(data_clean$participant_id)))
  
  # --- 3. Data Preprocessing ---
  print("--- Preprocessing data... ---")
  att_check_good_items <- c("fill_25", "fill_26", "fill_27", "fill_28")
  att_check_err_items <- c("fill_29", "fill_30", "fill_31", "fill_32")
  
d_processed <- data_clean %>%
  mutate(
    Block = case_when(
      # --- Main Task Blocks ---
      str_starts(trial_template, "Prac_Trivia") ~ "Prac_Trivia",
      str_starts(block_name, "Trivia_List") ~ "Trivia_List",
      block_name == "Questionnaire" ~ "Questionnaire", 
      trial_template == "Transcription_Instr" ~ "Transcription_Instr",
      trial_template == "adjust_volume_transcription" ~ "Volume_Adjust_Transcription",
      block_name == "Transcription" ~ "Transcription",
      TRUE ~ block_name 
    ),
    
    item_base = str_extract(stimuli_presented, "targ_\\d+|fill_\\d+"),
    item_type = case_when(
      str_starts(item_base, "targ_") ~ "target",
      item_base %in% att_check_good_items ~ "att_check_good",
      item_base %in% att_check_err_items ~ "att_check_err",
      str_starts(item_base, "fill_") ~ "filler_other",
      TRUE ~ "other_non_trivia"
    ),
    cond_letter = str_extract(stimuli_presented, "(?<=_)[ABCD](?=_)"),
    Condition = case_when(
      cond_letter == "A" ~ "correct",
      cond_letter == "B" ~ "phon_err",
      cond_letter == "C" ~ "non_phon_err",
      cond_letter == "D" ~ "both_err", 
      TRUE ~ NA_character_
    ),
    
    trial_duration_num = as.numeric(trial_duration),
    response_rt_num = as.numeric(response_rt)
  )
  
  # --- 4. Join with Stimulus Design File ---
  print(paste("--- Loading stimulus info from:", stimulus_filepath, "---"))
  stim_design <- read_csv(stimulus_filepath)
  
  stim_info <- stim_design %>%
    mutate(
      PhonErr_Details = str_c(phon_err_type, word_pairs, sep = "; ")
    ) %>%
    select(
      ID, 
      nonphon_err_type, 
      PhonErr_Details,
      Answer
    )
  
  d_processed <- d_processed %>%
    left_join(stim_info, by = c("item_base" = "ID"))
  
  print("--- Glimpse of data with new error type columns ---")
  print(
    d_processed %>%
      select(participant_id, item_base, Condition, nonphon_err_type, PhonErr_Details) %>%
      filter(str_starts(item_base, "targ_")) %>%
      head()
  )
  
  # --- 5. Participant and Trial Summaries ---
  print("--- Participants per Trivia List ---")
  participants_per_list <- d_processed %>%
    filter(Block == "Trivia_List") %>%
    distinct(participant_id, block_name) %>%
    group_by(block_name) %>%
    summarise(n_participants = n(), .groups = 'drop')
  print(participants_per_list)
  
  print("--- Trial Summary per Trivia List ---")
  unique_trial_tally <- d_processed %>%
    filter(Block == "Trivia_List") %>%
    filter(item_type != "other_non_trivia") %>%
    distinct(block_name, participant_id, item_base, item_type, Condition) %>%
    group_by(block_name, item_type, Condition) %>%
    summarise(n_unique_trials_total = n(), .groups = 'drop')
  
  list_summary <- unique_trial_tally %>%
    left_join(participants_per_list, by = "block_name") %>%
    mutate(
      trials_per_participant = n_unique_trials_total / n_participants
    ) %>%
    select(
      block_name, 
      item_type, 
      Condition, 
      trials_per_participant, 
      n_unique_trials_total, 
      n_participants
    ) %>%
    arrange(block_name, item_type, Condition)
  print(list_summary, n = Inf)
  
  print("--- Trial Summary for Transcription Block ---")
  participants_transcription <- d_processed %>%
    filter(Block == "Transcription") %>%
    distinct(participant_id, block_name) %>%
    group_by(block_name) %>%
    summarise(n_participants = n(), .groups = 'drop')
  
  unique_trials_transcription <- d_processed %>%
    filter(Block == "Transcription") %>%
    filter(!is.na(trial_num)) %>% 
    distinct(participant_id, block_name, trial_num, trial_template)
  
  transcription_total_tally <- unique_trials_transcription %>%
    group_by(block_name, trial_template) %>%
    summarise(n_unique_trials_total = n(), .groups = 'drop')
  
  transcription_summary <- transcription_total_tally %>%
    left_join(participants_transcription, by = "block_name") %>%
    mutate(
      trials_per_participant = n_unique_trials_total / n_participants
    ) %>%
    select(
      block_name,
      trial_template,
      trials_per_participant,
      n_unique_trials_total,
      n_participants
    ) %>%
    arrange(block_name, trial_template)
  print(transcription_summary, n = Inf)
  
  # --- 6. Time Spent ---
  print("--- Analyzing time spent... ---")
  
  # 6.1 Total Experiment Duration
  time_summary <- d_processed %>%
    distinct(participant_id, participation_duration) %>%
    mutate(duration_min = participation_duration / 60) 
  print("--- Total Experiment Duration (minutes) ---")
  print(summary(time_summary$duration_min))
  
  p_total_dur <- ggplot(time_summary, aes(x = duration_min)) +
    geom_histogram(binwidth = 5, fill = "steelblue", color = "black") +
    labs(
      title = "Total Experiment Duration per Participant",
      x = "Total Duration (minutes)",
      y = "Number of Participants"
    ) +
    theme_bw()
  print(p_total_dur)
  
  # 6.2 Time Spent per Block
  task_time_summary <- d_processed %>%
    filter(!is.na(Block) & !is.na(trial_duration_num)) %>% 
    group_by(participant_id, Block) %>%
    summarise(
      total_task_duration_ms = sum(trial_duration_num, na.rm = TRUE),
      .groups = 'drop'
    ) %>%
    mutate(total_task_duration_min = total_task_duration_ms / 60000) 
  
  print("--- Average Time per Task (minutes) ---")
  print(
    task_time_summary %>%
      group_by(Block) %>%
      summarise(mean_duration_min = mean(total_task_duration_min))
  )
  
  p_block_dur <- ggplot(task_time_summary, aes(x = Block, y = total_task_duration_min)) +
    geom_boxplot(fill = "lightblue") +
    labs(
      title = "Total Time Spent per Task (Block)",
      x = "Task (Block)",
      y = "Total Duration (minutes)"
    ) +
    theme_bw() +
    theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1),
          axis.text = element_text(size = 12))
  print(p_block_dur)
  
  # 6.3 Time Spent per Trial
  trial_time_data <- d_processed %>%
    filter(Block %in% c("Prac_Trivia", "Trivia_List", "Transcription", "Questionnaire")) %>%
    mutate(trial_duration_min = trial_duration_num / 60000)
  
  print("--- Summary of Trial Durations (minutes) ---")
  print(
    trial_time_data %>%
      group_by(Block) %>%
      summarise(
        mean_trial_min = mean(trial_duration_min, na.rm = TRUE),
        sd_trial_min = sd(trial_duration_min, na.rm = TRUE),
        median_trial_min = median(trial_duration_min, na.rm = TRUE)
      )
  )
  
  p_trial_dur <- ggplot(trial_time_data, aes(x = Block, y = trial_duration_min)) +
    geom_boxplot(fill = "lightgreen") +
    scale_y_log10() + 
    labs(
      title = "Trial Duration by Task",
      x = "Task (Block)",
      y = "Trial Duration (minutes, log scale)" 
    ) +
    theme_bw() +
    theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1),
          axis.text = element_text(size = 12))
  print(p_trial_dur)
  
#   # --- 7. Time-Based Outlier Analysis ---
#   print("--- Starting time-based outlier analysis... ---")

  # --- 8. Final Data for Analysis ---
  print("--- Creating final formatted dataset... ---")
  rows_to_exclude <- c(
    "Transcription_Instr",
    "volumeAdjusted|playTranscription|volumeAdjustPressC",
    "End_Main_Experiment",
    "questionnaire_part1_begin",
    "questionnaire_part2_begin",
    "confirmationCode",
    "End_Study"
  )
  
  d.final <- d_processed %>%
    filter(
      str_starts(block_name, "Trivia_List") | 
      block_name == "Transcription" | 
      block_name == "Questionnaire"
    ) %>%
    select(
      group_id, 
      participant_id, 
      response_value, 
      stimuli_presented, 
      stimulus_files_presented, 
      trial_num, 
      Block, 
      item_base, 
      item_type, 
      Condition, 
      nonphon_err_type, 
      PhonErr_Details, 
      Answer
    ) %>%
    rename(
      block = Block,
      condition = Condition,
      phon_err_details = PhonErr_Details,
      answer = Answer
    ) %>%
    filter(!stimuli_presented %in% rows_to_exclude) %>%
    mutate(
      second_attempt_used = case_when(
        str_detect(stimuli_presented, "Second_attempt") & 
          response_value != "I’m good — skip to the next question" ~ "Yes",
        str_detect(stimuli_presented, "Second_attempt") & 
          response_value == "I’m good — skip to the next question" ~ "No",
        TRUE ~ "No"
      )
    ) %>% 
    group_by(participant_id, block) %>%
    arrange(trial_num, .by_group = TRUE) %>% 
    mutate(
      trial_num_sequential = case_when(
        str_starts(block, "Trivia_List") ~ dense_rank(item_base),
        TRUE ~ row_number()
      )
    ) %>%
    ungroup() %>% 
    select(-trial_num)
  
  # --- 9. Final Sanity Checks & Write Files ---
  print("--- Running final sanity checks... ---")
  participant_count_final <- n_distinct(d.final$participant_id)
  print(paste("--- Total unique participants in final data:", participant_count_final))

    group_by(participant_id, block) %>%
    summarise(n_trials = n_distinct(trial_num_sequential), .groups = 'drop')
  print("--- Summary of trial counts (per participant per block) ---")
  print(trial_counts)
  
  block_counts <- d.final %>%
    distinct(participant_id, block) %>%
    group_by(block) %>%
    summarise(n_participants = n(), .groups = 'drop')
  print("--- Participants per block in final data ---")
  print(block_counts)
  
  # --- Write final data to CSV ---
  print("--- Writing final files... ---")
  
 # Define the output directory path
output_dir <- "./data/preprocessed/"

# Define output filenames using the new path and the prefix
file_all <- paste0(output_dir, output_prefix, "_all_data.csv")
file_trivia <- paste0(output_dir, output_prefix, "_trivia_data.csv")
file_q <- paste0(output_dir, output_prefix, "_questionnaire_data.csv")
file_trans <- paste0(output_dir, output_prefix, "_transcription_data.csv")

write_csv(d.final, file_all)

d.final %>%
  filter(str_detect(block, "Trivia_List")) %>%
  write_csv(file_trivia)

d.final %>%
  filter(str_detect(block, "Questionnaire")) %>%
  write_csv(file_q)

d.final %>%
  filter(str_detect(block, "Transcription")) %>%
  write_csv(file_trans)

print(paste("--- All files written successfully to:", output_dir, "---"))

return(d.final)
}
```

```{r sanity-checks-main-batch2-fixed-randomization-test-run}

# --------------------------------- #
# 1. New Randomization Checks
# --------------------------------- #

print("\n\n==================================================================")
print("=== PART 1: RUNNING NEW RANDOMIZATION SANITY CHECKS ===")
print("==================================================================")


d.check.random <- d_processed_main_batch2 %>%
  filter(str_detect(block, "Trivia_List")) %>%
  # Group by participant and stimulus
  group_by(participant_id, item_base) %>%
  # Arrange by the *actual* presentation order
  arrange(trial_order_actual) %>%
  mutate(true_attempt_num = (row_number() - 1) %/% 2 + 1) %>%
  ungroup()

# ---
# CHECK 1: Verify Label Alignment 
# ---
# This checks if the 'Second_attempt' label in 'stimuli_presented'
# EVER appears on a trial that is *actually* the first pass.
# This count MUST be 0 if the randomization is fixed.
print("--- CHECK 1: Verifying 'Second_attempt' label matches true trial order ---")

mismatched_attempts <- d.check.random %>%
  filter(
    true_attempt_num == 1 &
    str_detect(stimuli_presented, "Second_attempt")
  )

if (nrow(mismatched_attempts) == 0) {
  print(">>> SUCCESS: Randomization fixed! 'Second_attempt' labels only appear in the true second pass.")
  print(paste("    (Found 0 rows where 'Second_attempt' label was on a true first pass)"))
} else {
  print(paste(">>> ERROR: Found", nrow(mismatched_attempts), "rows where 'Second_attempt' label is on the TRUE first pass."))
  print("    This means the randomization is still broken.")
  print(head(mismatched_attempts))
}
cat("\n")


# ---
# CHECK 2: Verify Bundle Integrity (Sequential Trials) 
# ---
# This checks if all 4 rows (or 2) for a given stimulus
# appeared sequentially, with no other stimuli in between.
print("--- CHECK 2: Verifying stimulus bundles are sequential ---")

bundle_check <- d.check.random %>%
  group_by(participant_id, item_base) %>%
  # Get the min and max actual trial number for each bundle
  summarise(
    min_trial = min(trial_order_actual),
    max_trial = max(trial_order_actual),
    n_unique_trials = n_distinct(trial_order_actual),
    .groups = 'drop'
  ) %>%
  # The "span" of trial numbers should be (n_unique_trials - 1)
  # e.g., 2 unique trial numbers (162, 163) -> span = 163-162 = 1. n_unique = 2. (2-1) = 1.
  # e.g., 1 unique trial number (162) -> span = 162-162 = 0. n_unique = 1. (1-1) = 0.
  mutate(span_actual = max_trial - min_trial,
         span_expected = n_unique_trials - 1,
         is_sequential = (span_actual == span_expected))

broken_bundles <- bundle_check %>% filter(!is_sequential)

if (nrow(broken_bundles) == 0) {
  print(">>> SUCCESS: All trials for each stimulus are perfectly sequential (bundled).")
  print("    This confirms that 1st and 2nd attempts always occurred together.")
} else {
  print(paste(">>> ERROR: Found", nrow(broken_bundles), "bundles that are NOT sequential."))
  print("    This means a participant saw one attempt, then a different stimulus, then the second attempt.")
  print(head(broken_bundles))
}
cat("\n")


# ---
# CHECK 3: Verify Randomization of Bundles (Visual Check)
# ---
# This checks if the *bundles themselves* are randomized
# by printing the order of item_types for one participant.
print("--- CHECK 3: Verifying randomization of bundle *types* ---")

if (nrow(d.check.random) > 0) {
  # Get the first participant's ID
  sample_participant <- d.check.random$participant_id[1]
  
  trial_order_visual <- d.check.random %>%
    filter(participant_id == sample_participant) %>%
    # Get just the first row of each bundle (e.g., the choice response)
    group_by(item_base) %>%
    slice_head(n = 1) %>%
    ungroup() %>%
    arrange(trial_order_actual) %>%
    select(trial_order_actual, item_base, item_type)
  
  print(paste("Visual check of trial order for participant:", sample_participant))
  print(trial_order_visual, n = Inf)
  print("--- (Review the 'item_type' column. It should appear mixed/randomized.) ---")
  
} else {
  print("--- Could not perform visual check: No 'Trivia_List' data found. ---")
}

print("==================================================================")
print("=== ALL SANITY CHECKS COMPLETE ===")
print("==================================================================")
```

```{r main-batch1-reformatting-filter-out-second-pass}
# ---------------------------------
# 1. Load the Data
# ---------------------------------
# Load the main data file
d.batch1.original <- read_csv("./data/preprocessed/main_110425_random_fail_48subj_trivia_data.csv")

# ---------------------------------
# 2. Mark the True First Pass (Your Question 1)
# ---------------------------------
# We group by participant AND the unique stimulus ID (item_base)
# Then, we arrange by the *actual* trial number to find the true first instance
# Finally, we create a new column 'true_attempt_num' (1 = first, 2 = second)
# Since each "attempt" has two rows (choice + text), we use integer
# division `(row_number() - 1) %/% 2 + 1` to group the first
# two rows (1,2) as attempt 1, and the next two rows (3,4) as attempt 2.

d.marked <- d.batch1.original %>%
  group_by(participant_id, item_base) %>%
  arrange(trial_num_sequential) %>%
  mutate(true_attempt_num = (row_number() - 1) %/% 2 + 1) %>%
  ungroup()

# --- Sanity Check ---
# Let's look at a participant who had a "Second_attempt" trial
# to see if our new column 'true_attempt_num' correctly identified
# the *real* first and second passes.
print("--- Sanity Check: Comparing 'stimuli_presented' to 'true_attempt_num' ---")

# This will find rows where the 'stimuli_presented' column *contains* "Second_attempt"
# and shows our new numbering. You'll likely see cases where
# stimuli_presented == "Second_attempt|..." BUT true_attempt_num == 1
check_data <- d.marked %>%
  filter(grepl("Second_attempt", stimuli_presented)) %>%
  select(participant_id, item_base, trial_num_sequential, stimuli_presented, true_attempt_num)

print(head(check_data))
cat("\n\n")

# --- New Check: Isolate Target Trials ---
# This check filters for trials where 'item_base' does NOT start with 'fill_'
print("--- Sanity Check: Isolating Target Trials (non-fillers) ---")
target_check_data <- d.marked %>%
  filter(!grepl("fill_", item_base)) %>%
  select(participant_id, item_base, trial_num_sequential, stimuli_presented, true_attempt_num)

# Print the first few rows of this new check
print(head(target_check_data))
cat("\n\n")


# ---------------------------------
# 3. Filter for ONLY the First Pass (Your Question 2)
# ---------------------------------
# Now that we have the 'true_attempt_num' column,
# we can simply filter for all the rows where it equals 1.
# This will keep *both* rows (choice and text) for the true first attempt.

d.first_pass_only <- d.marked %>%
  filter(true_attempt_num == 1)

print("--- Data filtered for first pass only ---")
# This dataframe now has only one row per participant per stimulus,
# and it is the *true* first time they encountered it.
print(d.first_pass_only)


# ---------------------------------
# 4. Add Sorting Category 
# ---------------------------------
# Create a new column to define the sort order:
# 1 = attention checks (item_type starts with "att_check_")
# 2 = target trials (item_base does NOT contain "fill_")
# 3 = other filler trials
d.first_pass_with_sort_cat <- d.first_pass_only %>%
  mutate(
    sort_category = case_when(
      startsWith(item_type, "att_check_") ~ 1,
      !grepl("fill_", item_base)         ~ 2,
      TRUE                              ~ 3
    )
  )

# ---------------------------------
# 5. Sort Data by New Order
# ---------------------------------
# Now, arrange the data first by participant, then by the new sort category,
# and finally by the original trial number as a tie-breaker.
d.first_pass_sorted <- d.first_pass_with_sort_cat %>%
  arrange(participant_id, sort_category, trial_num_sequential)

# ---------------------------------
# 6. Add Participant Number 
# ---------------------------------
# Create a mapping of the long participant_id string to a simple integer
participant_map <- d.first_pass_sorted %>%
  distinct(participant_id) %>%
  arrange(participant_id) %>% # Arrange to ensure consistent numbering
  mutate(participant_num = row_number())

# Join this new integer ID back to the main sorted dataframe
d.final_with_num <- d.first_pass_sorted %>%
  left_join(participant_map, by = "participant_id") %>%
  # Move the new participant_num column to be near the front
  select(participant_num, participant_id, everything())

# ---------------------------------
# 7. Save the New, Sorted Data (Updated Step)
# ---------------------------------
# This is the final file, now including 'participant_num'
write_csv(d.final_with_num, "./data/preprocessed/main_data_first_pass_sorted_with_num_batch1_48subj.csv")

# --- Optional: Print head of new data to check ---
print("--- Head of final sorted data (d.final_with_num) ---")
print(head(d.final_with_num))
```

```{r accent-familiarity-error-detection-rate-analysis-sanity-checks}
tryCatch({
  # ---
  # 1. Load Data
  # ---
  df_fb <- read_csv("./data/Exp1-DATA - FB.csv")
  df_jb <- read_csv("./data/Exp1-DATA - JB.csv")
  df_quest <- read_csv("./data/preprocessed/main_110425_random_fail_48subj_questionnaire_data.csv")
  

  # ---
  # 2. Combine Experimental Data
  # ---
  df_exp_all <- bind_rows(df_fb, df_jb)

  # ---
  # 3. Mark Participants based on score (< 6/8 OR 4/7)
  # ---
  print("Applying new combined failure criterion (< 6/8 OR 4/7)...")
  
  df_exp_all <- df_exp_all %>%
    mutate(
      
      comments = as.character(comments),
      
     
      attention_score_8 = as.numeric(
        str_extract(comments, "(?<=\\()\\d+(?=\\/8)")
      ),
      
     
      attention_score_7 = as.numeric(
        str_extract(comments, "(?<=\\()\\d+(?=\\/7)")
      )
    )


  failed_participants_8 <- df_exp_all %>%
    filter(attention_score_8 < 6) %>%
    pull(participant_id) %>%
    unique()
    
  failed_participants_7 <- df_exp_all %>%
    filter(attention_score_7 == 4) %>%
    pull(participant_id) %>%
    unique()
  
 
  failed_participants <- union(failed_participants_8, failed_participants_7)

  print(paste("Found", length(failed_participants), "total unique participants who failed."))
  print("Failed participant IDs:")
  print(failed_participants)


  df_exp_all <- df_exp_all %>%
    mutate(attention_check_passed = !participant_id %in% failed_participants)
  
 

  # ---
  # 4. Sanity Check
  # ---
  print("--- Sanity Check (New combined rule): Participants who Passed/Failed ---")
  
  status_counts <- df_exp_all %>%
    distinct(participant_id, attention_check_passed) %>%
    count(attention_check_passed)
  
  print(status_counts)
 

  # ---
  # 5. Join with Questionnaire Data
  # ---
  print("Joining with questionnaire data...")
  
  df_final_joined <- df_exp_all %>%
    left_join(df_quest, by = "participant_id")
})
```

```{r accent-familiarity-error-detection-rate-analysis}
print("Preparing data for Plot 1 (calculating per-participant error)...")

# 1. Create labels *first*
df_analysis_labeled <- df_analysis_data %>%
  mutate(
    err_reported_label = case_when(
      err_reported_clean == "nans" ~ "Question has no errors",
      err_reported_clean == "nun"  ~ "Unsure",
      err_reported_clean == "y"    ~ "Question needs correction"
    ),
    condition.x = factor(condition.x, levels = c("correct", "phon_err", "non_phon_err", "both_err"))
  )

# 2. Calculate proportions *per participant*
# We use complete() to ensure all 0s are filled in
participant_props <- df_analysis_labeled %>%
  # Count responses for each participant/condition/response_type
  count(participant_id, condition.x, err_reported_label) %>%
  
  # Explicitly fill in 0s for missing combinations
  complete(participant_id, condition.x, err_reported_label, fill = list(n = 0)) %>%
  
  # Calculate per-participant proportions
  group_by(participant_id, condition.x) %>%
  mutate(
    Total_Trials = sum(n),
    Proportion = n / Total_Trials
  ) %>%
  ungroup()

# 3. Calculate Group Mean, N, and Standard Error
plot_summary_with_error_grouped <- participant_props %>%
  group_by(condition.x, err_reported_label) %>%
  summarise(
    N = n(),
    Mean_Proportion = mean(Proportion, na.rm = TRUE),
    SD = sd(Proportion, na.rm = TRUE),
    SE = SD / sqrt(N),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  # Calculate the min/max for the error bars
  mutate(
    ymin = Mean_Proportion - SE,
    ymax = Mean_Proportion + SE
  )

print("--- Plot Summary for Grouped Chart (Head) ---")
print(head(plot_summary_with_error_grouped))


# ---

# ---

                               ymin = ymin,
                               ymax = ymax

  geom_bar(stat = "identity", position = position_dodge(width = 0.9), color = "black") +
  
  # --- ADDED ERROR BARS ---
```

```{r accent-familiarity-error-detection-rate-analysis-another-way-to-plot-data}
# ---
# 2. Calculate Stimuli Totals (The Denominators)
# ---
# We need the total number of stimuli for each condition (217, 207, 210)
stimuli_totals <- df_analysis_data %>%
  # Note: We do NOT filter for "y" here
  count(condition.x) %>%
  rename(Total_Stimuli = n)

print("--- Total Stimuli per Condition (Denominators) ---")
print(stimuli_totals)

# ---
# 3. Calculate Detections (The Numerators)
# ---
# Now we filter for "y" responses and define "detection"
detections <- df_analysis_data %>%
  filter(err_reported_clean == "y") %>%
  
  # Create new columns to define a "hit"
  mutate(
    # A "Phonological Error" is detected if they say "p" OR "both"
    Phon_Detected = err_type_response %in% c("p", "both"),
    
    # A "Non-Phonological Error" is detected if they say "np" OR "both"
    NonPhon_Detected = err_type_response %in% c("np", "both")
  ) %>%
  
  # Group by condition and sum the hits
  group_by(condition.x) %>%
  summarise(
    Phon_Detections = sum(Phon_Detected),
    NonPhon_Detections = sum(NonPhon_Detected)
  )

print("--- Errors Detected per Condition (Numerators) ---")
print(detections)

# ---
# 4. Join and Calculate Proportions
# ---
# This joins the numerators and denominators
plot_data_summary <- stimuli_totals %>%
  left_join(detections, by = "condition.x") %>%
  
  # Calculate the proportions from your stats
  mutate(
    `phonological error` = Phon_Detections / Total_Stimuli,
    `nonphonological error` = NonPhon_Detections / Total_Stimuli
  ) %>%
  
  # Filter out the "correct" condition which isn't plotted
  filter(condition.x != "correct") %>%
  
  # Select only the columns we need
  select(Stimulus_Condition = condition.x, `phonological error`, `nonphonological error`) %>%
  
  # Pivot to the "long" format for ggplot
  pivot_longer(
    cols = c(`phonological error`, `nonphonological error`),
    names_to = "Error_Type_Detected",
    values_to = "Proportion"
  ) %>%
  
  # Filter out the NAs (e.g., non-phon errors for phon_err stimuli)
  filter(!is.na(Proportion))

    axis.text.y = element_text(size = 14),
    axis.title = element_text(size = 16, face = "bold"),
    plot.title = element_text(face = "bold"),
    legend.title = element_text(face = "bold", size = 14),
    legend.text = element_text(size = 14),
    legend.position = "top"
  )

# Print the plot
print(p_hit_rate_chart)


#######ERROR BARS

# ---
# 1. Load and Clean Base Data
# ---
print("Loading and cleaning base data...")
# (Assuming df_analysis_base is already created from previous steps)
# (If not, re-run the loading/cleaning code)


# 2. Prepare Data for Plot 2 (Per-Participant)
# ---
print("Preparing data for Plot 2 (calculating per-participant error)...")

# 1. Calculate Stimuli Totals per participant
stimuli_totals_pp <- df_analysis_data %>%
  group_by(participant_id, condition.x) %>%
  count(name = "Total_Stimuli")

# 2. Calculate Detections per participant
detections_pp <- df_analysis_data %>%
  filter(err_reported_clean == "y") %>%
  mutate(
    Phon_Detected = err_type_response %in% c("p", "both"),
    NonPhon_Detected = err_type_response %in% c("np", "both")
  ) %>%
  group_by(participant_id, condition.x) %>%
  summarise(
    Phon_Detections = sum(Phon_Detected),
    NonPhon_Detections = sum(NonPhon_Detected),
    .groups = "drop"
  )

# 3. Join and Calculate Proportions per participant
participant_hit_rates <- stimuli_totals_pp %>%
  left_join(detections_pp, by = c("participant_id", "condition.x")) %>%
  mutate(
    Phon_Detections = ifelse(is.na(Phon_Detections), 0, Phon_Detections),
    NonPhon_Detections = ifelse(is.na(NonPhon_Detections), 0, NonPhon_Detections)
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    `phonological error` = Phon_Detections / Total_Stimuli,
    `nonphonological error` = NonPhon_Detections / Total_Stimuli
  ) %>%
  filter(condition.x != "correct") %>%
  select(participant_id, Stimulus_Condition = condition.x, `phonological error`, `nonphonological error`) %>%
  pivot_longer(
    cols = c(`phonological error`, `nonphonological error`),
    names_to = "Error_Type_Detected",
    values_to = "Proportion"
  )

# 4. Calculate Group Mean, SE, and **NEW "HITS ONLY" FILTER**
plot_summary_with_error <- participant_hit_rates %>%

  # --- THIS IS THE NEW FILTER ---
  # Filter to only show "hits" and remove "false alarms"
  filter(
    (Stimulus_Condition == "phon_err" & Error_Type_Detected == "phonological error") |
    (Stimulus_Condition == "non_phon_err" & Error_Type_Detected == "nonphonological error") |
    (Stimulus_Condition == "both_err") # Keep both bars for the 'both_err' condition
  ) %>%
  # --- END NEW FILTER ---

  group_by(Stimulus_Condition, Error_Type_Detected) %>%
  summarise(
    N = n(),
    Mean_Proportion = mean(Proportion, na.rm = TRUE),
    SD = sd(Proportion, na.rm = TRUE),
    SE = SD / sqrt(N),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    ymin = Mean_Proportion - SE,
    ymax = Mean_Proportion + SE
  ) %>%
  mutate(Stimulus_Condition = factor(Stimulus_Condition, 
                                     levels = c("phon_err", "non_phon_err", "both_err")))

print("--- Plot Summary with Error Bars (HITS ONLY) ---")
print(plot_summary_with_error)

# ---
# 5. Create Plot 2 (Hit Rate) - "Hits Only"
# ---
# The plotting code itself doesn't need to change.
# It will now receive data that has already been filtered.
p_hit_rate_chart <- ggplot(plot_summary_with_error, 
                           aes(x = Stimulus_Condition, 
                               y = Mean_Proportion,
                               fill = Error_Type_Detected,
                               ymin = ymin,
                               ymax = ymax
                           )) +
  
  geom_bar(stat = "identity", position = position_dodge(width = 0.9), color = "black", linewidth = 0.2) +
  
  geom_errorbar(
    position = position_dodge(width = 0.9), 
    width = 0.25,
    color = "black"
  ) +
  
  scale_fill_manual(values = c("phonological error" = "skyblue", 
                               "nonphonological error" = "salmon")) +
  
  scale_y_continuous(labels = scales::percent_format()) +
  labs(
    x = "Condition",
    y = "Proportion of Errors Detected",
    fill = "Error Type Detected"
  ) +
  theme_bw() +
  theme(
    axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1, size = 14),
    axis.text.y = element_text(size = 14),
    axis.title = element_text(size = 16, face = "bold"),
    plot.title = element_text(face = "bold", size = 16),
    legend.title = element_text(face = "bold", size = 14),
    legend.text = element_text(size = 14),
    legend.position = "top"
  )

print(p_hit_rate_chart)
```

```{r accent-familiarity-interacts-with-error-detection-rate-analysis}
# Isolate the familiarity data from the full joined file
df_familiarity <- df_final_joined %>%

# Join familiarity data with our clean trial data

  # Remove any participants who didn't answer this question

  count(exposure_spanish_accent, condition.x, err_reported_clean) %>%

  # Create labels

    legend.text = element_text(size = 12),
    legend.position = "top",
    strip.text = element_text(size = 12, face = "bold", color = "black") # Controls the facet labels
  )
```
